name: wanderpage
description: Turn a folder of travel photos on this Mac into a private, curated static trip page.
long_description: Wanderpage reads a photo folder, selects and orders the photos, and builds a static trip page you can host anywhere. It never identifies people, never publishes exact GPS, removes photo metadata, and runs a privacy scan before anything is published. The extension starts the MCP server from your Wanderpage project folder (the one `npx @buildproven/wanderpage` made, `~/wanderpage` by default), so your photos and drafts stay on this Mac.

project.title: Wanderpage project folder
project.description: The folder `npx @buildproven/wanderpage` set up (~/wanderpage by default). Drafts and the published site live here.

openai_api_key.title: OpenAI API key (optional)
openai_api_key.description: Enables the full edit and strict people exclusion. Without it, Wanderpage ranks photos by technical quality only.

tools.name: publish_site
tools.description: Publish a trip and build the site
